summary: Adds a read-only staging cleanup probe to checkpoint resume views so terminal evidence requires committed staging files and receipt directories to be absent from the live staging root.
audit_findings: Rev0679 verified durable rows plus live source/destination filesystem truth, but terminal resume still trusted staging cleanup as database history only.
A stale .part file or .part.chunks receipt directory under staging_root_path could coexist with staging_artifacts_cleaned=1 unless read-time staging truth was checked.
The new probe cross-checks file_results, apply_intents, and source manifest entry digests before inspecting reconstructed staging paths.
resume_staging_checks: require_staging_artifacts_cleaned defaults to true and requires staging_root_path for strict terminal resume views.
SyncStagingArtifactsProbe joins cleaned sync_session_file_results rows to sync_session_apply_intents and source sync_session_manifest_entries rows.
The probe requires apply intent remote_entry_digest to match the persisted source manifest entry_digest.
The expected .part path is reconstructed from the persisted source path and digest, then compared to absolute_staging_path.
The expected .part file and .part.chunks receipt directory must be absent for staging_artifacts_verified=true.
Advisory mode reports staging_files_present, staging_receipt_directories_present, staging_artifact_kind_mismatches, and bounded staging_artifact_paths without rejecting the view.
